Definition: from the same as G4460; Rachab, a Canaanitess:--Rachab.
BiblicalUsage: Salmon begat Booz of Rachab, and Booz begat Obed of Ruth. Rachab is Rahab of Jericho, the Canaanite woman who sheltered the spies, written into the genealogy of Jesus.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe her name is in the genealogy because grace writes outsiders into the family line.
